svg.title: Torricelli outflow from a large open reservoir
svg.desc: Water drains from a small side opening into the atmosphere. The large free surface is at height h1 and the outlet center at h2, with h=h1-h2. Both have atmospheric pressure. Negligible free-surface speed and negligible losses give outlet speed square root of 2gh. A schematic parabolic jet leaves the outlet horizontally. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: A draining tank loses head, so its jet slows and shortens
Ideal quasi-steady flow: A = 0.50 m², outlet a = 0.0020 m², initial head 2 m. Outlet is 0.50 m above
ground. No losses or air drag; water below the outlet remains. Model time is slowed.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
